isolation: Fresh isolated loopback H2 database per suite. No push, deployment, publication or online database writes. Existing suites may test formal evaluation/publication only inside their disposable local test databases.
fixtureNotes: Review pagination created 25 real new pending submissions across real isolated assignments, plus two seed submissions. The normal one-pending-version-per-work restriction was retained.
HTTP 503, delayed/out-of-order reads and failed review saves are explicit local response fixtures.
Historical pending/latest behavior, stale drafts, former teacher-to-assistant metadata privacy, stable tie sorting and next-selection live state were validated using actual H2 rows in backend tests.
The old rich-editor test assumed the first row was the latest submission. It now selects the exact student v2, retaining image/math/table/frozen-submission assertions.
New review screenshots were visually checked in dark desktop and 390px mobile layouts.
